item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00217","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C11","C24","C06"],"selected_candidate_label":"C11","confidence":0.97,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C11 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template for the child. Both orders first transfer functions from one department or officer to another agency and then transfer the associated records, property, and unexpended funds needed to perform those functions, with the Director of the Bureau of the Budget controlling or approving the funds transfer. This combination, sequence, and closely parallel wording are materially more distinctive than a generic transfer of authority. C24 and C06 share transfer machinery but not the same function-plus-resources-and-funds structure.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"All functions of administration ... now vested in or exercised by the Secretary of the Army ... together with ... supplies, equipment ... and ... cemetery records ... are hereby transferred to the American Battle Monuments Commission","parent_excerpt":"The Administrator for Economic Cooperation shall perform the functions heretofore performed by the Secretary of State ... There shall be transferred to the Economic Cooperation Administration so much of the personnel, records, and property of the Department of State which relate to said functions","explanation":"Both use a two-part administrative reorganization: reassignment of existing functions followed by transfer of the records and tangible resources associated with those functions."},{"child_excerpt":"There shall be transferred to the American Battle Monuments Commission so much of the unexpended balances of appropriations now, or which may become, available to the Department of the Army for the performance of the functions transferred by the provisions of this order as the Director of the Bureau of the Budget may deem necessary","parent_excerpt":"so much of the unexpended balance of funds now available to the Department of State ... as the Secretary of State and the Administrator for Economic Cooperation shall jointly determine to be necessary for use in connection with such functions; provided that any such transfer of funds shall have the approval of the Director of the Bureau of the Budget","explanation":"The child closely reproduces C11's distinctive fiscal-transfer clause: transfer only the necessary portion of unexpended funds associated with the transferred functions, under Bureau of the Budget supervision."}]}
